Package com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.config

Class ServerConfig

java.lang.Object
com.github.crittscott.somegoogly.config.ServerConfig
public class ServerConfig extends Object
Server-authoritative spawn settings. The googly-eye chance lives here (not in the bundled eye datapack), so admins can tune how common eyes are — globally and per entity — without touching the shipped eye-definition datapacks. Those JSONs only decide where eyes go and whether an entity is eligible at all (their enabled flag is an authoritative hard on/off, applied in ServerServices); this class decides how often an eligible entity actually rolls eyes. Also hosts the picker's opt-in gate for the destructive /sg spawnall grid (ALLOW_SPAWN_ALL, enforced by the server command).

  • Method Details

    • enabledBehaviors

      public static List<EyeBehavior> enabledBehaviors()
      The behaviors eligible for ambient play: every registered behavior whose id appears in AMBIENT_BEHAVIOR_POOL. Unknown ids in the config are simply ignored.

    • percentFor

      public static int percentFor(net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation entityType)
      The configured eye chance (0–100) for the given entity: an exact override if one matches, else the first matching wildcard override, else GLOBAL_PERCENT.

    • isSpawnExcluded

      public static boolean isSpawnExcluded(net.minecraft.resources.ResourceLocation entityType)
      Whether /sg spawn and /sg spawnall should skip this entity type: its exact id is listed in SPAWN_EXCLUDED_ENTITIES, or its namespace in SPAWN_EXCLUDED_MODS. Purely an authoring-command filter — it has no bearing on eye eligibility or natural spawning.

    • resetDefaults

      public static void resetDefaults()
      Restore built-in defaults before a loader applies a newly opened world's values.

    • validateResourceLocation

      public static boolean validateResourceLocation(String value)
      Whether a config string parses as a ResourceLocation; the entry guard for AMBIENT_BEHAVIOR_POOL, SPAWN_EXCLUDED_ENTITIES, and the client's disabledEntities.

    • validateNamespace

      public static boolean validateNamespace(String value)
      Whether a config string is a bare resource-location namespace; the entry guard for SPAWN_EXCLUDED_MODS, the client's disabledMods, and the /sg spawnall filter.

    • validateOverride

      public static boolean validateOverride(String value)
      Whether a config string is a well-formed override line (parse(java.lang.String)); the entry guard for ENTITY_OVERRIDES.
